newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Seylan Merchant Bank sells receivables.
newsitem.headline: Seylan Merchant Bank sells receivables.

text.p: Seylan Merchant Bank Ltd has sold margin trading receivables totalling 185.2 million rupees ($3.2 million) to a factoring company, a bank official said on Tuesday.

The official, who declined to be identified, confirmed a report in the government-run Daily News which said the bank had also accepted 2.5 million shares in one of its borrowers, Magnum Fund Ltd, as part payment of 71.1 million rupees of debt.
Seylan Merchant Bank is a unit of Seylan Bank.
